tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: phur sgrub thugs kyi nying khu las: phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo: phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa byed par 'dod pas: gang 'thad kyi gnas su ci ltar 'byor ba'i gtor tshogs bshams shing sngon du 'gro ba'i chos spyod ci ltar rigs par byas la: dang po mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas chen po la: bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i ming yang med: de ltar ye nas gsal bar rab rtogs pas: mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: bshags pa ni: hūm̐: brdal khyab ka dag yang dag lhun 'byams la: bshags dang bshags bya'i mtshan ma rang sar dag: 'on kyang ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul srid na: rang byung sprul pa'i lha tshogs rnams la bshags: sa ma ya: a a: sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlab pa ni: gdod nas rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi mchog: rgyu drug dbyings su bsgral pa'i dmar chen po: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ma hā ba liṃ ta: rnam gsum 'dzad med bcud chen ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: bskyed rim ni: hūm̐: snang ba'i dngos po sna tshogs gzhal yas khang: stong pa'i rang mdangs dpal chen dkyil 'khor lha: rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rang byung gsal: lhun grub lus kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol ni: rang bzhin dbyings na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs rnams: spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang: thugs rje gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis: spyan 'dren gshegs gsol gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ: de dag la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: lhan cig skyes sbyar phyi nang gsang bkod pa'i: mchod pa rnam mang dngos 'byor yid sprul pas: rang byung sprul pa'i lha la mchod par 'bul: gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes su gsol: ma hā pū tsa ho: sman raka gtor gsum 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar sman chen po:

nyon mongs mkha' dbyings gsang ba'i rak+ta mchog: bcud chen rdzas mchog gtor mar bcas te 'bul: ma hā a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: dug gsum sha khrag mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gti mug sha yi rang bzhin ri ltar bsnyil: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs: zhe sdang rus pa'i phung po bcas pa rnams: rdo rje srin po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐: bstod pa ni: ā+oṃ: lha tshogs sku yi rang bzhin 'gyur ba med: ā: lha tshogs gsung gi rang bzhin 'gag pa med: hūm̐: lha tshogs thugs kyi rang bzhin 'khrul pa med: cho 'phrul sprul bsgyur mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod: bsnyen pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu sras 'khor bcas: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs klong nas khro gar mdzad: grags stong sngags kyi dzap dbyangs 'brug sgra sgrog: thugs dam dbyings nas ma 'grub bar du bsgrub: ā+oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba big nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: tshogs las ni: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud gsang bar yongs bkod pa'i: longs spyod ga ṇa tsakrar byin brlabs pa: dpal chen yab yum 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: thugs dam dbyings su bskang phyir bzhes su gsol: ga ṇa tsakra ma hā dz+nyā na pū dza ho: skong ba ni: hūm̐: bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang: snang ba yab kyi thugs dam bskang: stong pa yum gyi thugs dam bskang: gnyis med rol pa chen por bskang: tshogs bshags pa ni: hūm̐: bdag ni ye nas rang byung rig rtsal ngang: 'khrul med rtog bral chag nyams rang sar grol: snang sems 'dzin pa zhugs na dbyings su bshags: bskul ba ni: hūm̐: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo bskul lo gnad nas bskul: rdo rje gzhon nu 'khor bcas rnams: zhi rgyas dbang drag las mdzod cig: lhag gtor ni: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis lha tshogs mchod: bar du tshogs kyis mched lcam bskang: tha ma lhag ma'i gtor ma 'dis: gang gi dbang ba tshims gyur cig:

ā+oṃ uts+tshiṣ+ṭa bhak+ṣa khā hi: chad mdo ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i: bka' yi srung ma dam tshig can: sngon gyi tha tshig rjes dgongs la: gtor ma longs shig phrin las mdzod: skyong ma gyer ba ni: bh+yo: snang zhing srid pa'i 'jig rten na: gnas pa'i brtan skyong gnas 'dir gshegs: rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: gtor mnan ni: hūm̐: nyon mongs rgyu drug rkyen bzhi'i tshogs: ma rig gis bskyed bag chags rnams: rang byung rig rtogs ri rab 'og: gzhi rdzogs bar mtshams med par mnan: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: chos sku ka dag lhun 'byams bkra shis ni: longs sku rang byung 'od gsal ngang du shog: sprul sku sna tshogs 'gro 'dul bkra shis ni: thabs mkhas thugs rje snying rje'i ngang du shog: gshegs su gsol ba ni: thugs rje kun khyab lha tshogs rnams: rang bzhin 'od lnga'i klong du thim: 'od lnga longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba: snod bcud chos sku'i klong du 'o: bsngo ba ni: bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum gyis: dus gsum tshogs gnyis ci bsags pa: bsgyur rdzogs yang dag chen por bsngo: ngo bo gnyis med 'bras thob shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gang zag ku su lu pa dang: rings drags nas longs med pa rnams kyi don du mtsho rgyal gyis: mkhas rdzong shel brag phug tu mdzad pa phrin las lam khyer bsdus pa rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: kha tham: dha thim: sprul pa'i skyes mchog sangs rgyas gling pas kong po rtse chen brag dmar nas gdan drangs pa'o/// /
